title: sx12xx modem-hold semantics break TX once async RX is armed; L2 needs driver-level arbitration contract
description: Found by 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-sb0b (all three reviewers converged, P0). Upstream sx12xx (v3.7.0, incl. patches/zephyr-v3.7.0-local.patch which does not touch modem semantics): sx12xx_lora_recv_async() takes modem_acquire() and holds modem_usage=BUSY for the entire armed lifetime; sx12xx_ev_rx_done() auto-re-arms Radio.Rx(0) and never releases. Consequences once L2 arms async RX (sb0b): every lora_send() fails -EBUSY at the driver's modem_acquire (all TX dead on Heltec/T-Deck/nRF SX12xx boards); L2-level modem_mutex/tx_pending arbitration does not help because the driver never consults them. Note the driver ALSO silently overwrites the callback on double-arm (opposite of loopback's -EBUSY). Fix options: (a) L2 wraps TX with explicit disarm (recv_async(dev,NULL)) + re-arm under its existing modem_mutex, or (b) drivers release the modem between async frames and L2 keeps one-shot re-arm, or (c) driver-level arbitration with a written contract in lora_l2.h. Coordinate with the TX-side async refactor (child of project-LICHEN-worker6-9hfe) before choosing. Also verify modem_release clears async_rx_cb (suspected pre-existing leak). Test-only loopback half of this was fixed inside sb0b (one-shot delivery).
